title: AgentGroupChat: An Interactive Group Chat Simulacra For Better Eliciting Emergent Behavior
reasoning: The paper includes a 'Philosophical Discourses' scenario where agents representing famous philosophers (Nietzsche, Zhuangzi, Aristotle, and Kant) debate the ethical implications, morality, and human welfare impact of artificial intelligence. The study evaluates the agents' ability to adhere to these complex philosophical and moral frameworks.
